status: retrospectively documented development protocol; not day-one preregistration
question: How accurately and with what uncertainty can DE-LU day-ahead prices be forecast from information available before the auction, and how does that accuracy affect constrained battery value?
success_test: On a predeclared untouched evaluation period with verified input vintages, LightGBM must beat LEAR on mean pinball loss, achieve the declared interval-calibration target, and report point accuracy against naive plus battery value under matched costs and constraints.

final_holdout.status: NOT ASSIGNED; freeze dates before accessing outcomes

primary_loss: daily mean pinball loss across 0.1,0.5,0.9 quantiles; challenger versus LEAR

calibration_target.note: Operational target, not a formal coverage guarantee; report sampling uncertainty and dependence.

selection_policy: Tune only within chronological training/calibration windows. Never select models, window lengths, cost assumptions or reported periods using final-holdout results.
trial_policy: Record successful and failed executions; distinguish configuration variants, test signatures, inner alpha selection, and repeated runs. Earlier unarchived attempts remain unknown.
inference_policy: Current DM tests compare daily absolute losses, not the primary pinball objective. Archived Holm adjustments are diagnostic only. A final primary pinball comparison must be predeclared with its dependence treatment and hypothesis family before opening the holdout.
publication_evidence_gate: BLOCKED: current historical forecast vintages unverified. --require-verified-vintages fails closed.
sensitivity_policy: Fixed one-factor-at-a-time battery grid; every policy reoptimised under each scenario; not used to choose a preferred trading strategy.
